name: SETT's Deterministic Governance Boundary Benchmark
description: First published results for SGBS-01, SETT's Deterministic Governance Boundary Benchmark: sett_native vs. langgraph_baseline vs. langgraph_policy under two conditions: the SETT v0.12.0 baseline and a targeted latency patch (ablation, commit 204a368). Correctness dry runs and steady-state action latency, fully local. See sgbs-01/README.md for the frozen protocol, how to reproduce, and full results.
